driver: Scoreless draw at 30' continues to decay both team-win contracts toward lower values as draw probability rises. Everton already drifted down 3 cents over 5 minutes (22.5→21.5), showing this decay pattern is active. At 0-0 with 15 minutes remaining in first half, expect modest continuation of this drift.
falsifier: Everton scores or creates sustained pressure visible in next update, reversing the decay. Alternatively, if game remains perfectly quiet and market makers tighten spread to sub-1 cent, the drift could stall at current level.
